Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Operations Manager position at Harbor Logistics. With more than ten years of progressive experience in warehouse, transportation, and port-adjacent distribution operations, I am prepared to lead teams that move freight reliably, control cost, and meet the service standards your customers expect.

In my current role as Operations Supervisor at Chesapeake Freight Partners, I oversee daily execution across a 220,000-square-foot distribution center and a regional linehaul network. I manage a team of 48 supervisors, leads, and hourly associates; coordinate inbound and outbound schedules with carriers and terminal partners; and own the weekly operating review that tracks on-time performance, dock-to-stock cycle time, damage rates, and overtime. Over the past three years we have raised on-time dispatch from 91 percent to 97.4 percent, reduced shrink and damage claims by 28 percent, and cut overtime hours by 18 percent without adding headcount, largely through clearer shift handoffs, a revised slotting plan, and tighter carrier appointment discipline.

Harbor Logistics’ focus on coastal and inland freight, and its reputation for dependable service into the Mid-Atlantic, is a close match for the work I have done and the work I want to do next. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to strengthen cross-dock and warehouse flow, improve carrier compliance, and build a culture in which safety and throughput are managed together rather than traded off. I am comfortable owning the operating plan, the labor model, and the relationships with customers, carriers, and union or non-union frontline teams, and I report results in plain language that leadership can act on.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my experience in multi-site logistics operations can support Harbor Logistics’ service and cost objectives. Thank you for your time and consideration. I am available at your convenience and can be reached at (410) 555-0186 or daniel.okafor@email.com.
